notes: Synthetic test script only: every sentence here was written for testing and is spoken by generic TTS voices, never a person's recording. 'expect' is checked on the final text VocalCode would type; 'reference' is the intended words for WER/CER. Negative cases (feature 'guard') must NOT trigger any rule.
